bugs_fixed.description: budget_greedy compared current_resident_bytes (base weights) against residual_budget — conceptually wrong
bugs_fixed.root_cause: base layer bytes and residual bytes are different memory pools; comparing them caused over-allocation
bugs_fixed.fix: Use resident_residual_bytes() to compare residual-to-residual; also add independent budget-based residual eviction

bugs_fixed.description: Parallel prefill IO time used single layer size instead of full model payload
bugs_fixed.root_cause: prefill_io_ms = io_time_ms(layer_mb, io_mbps) computed IO for one layer, not all 56
bugs_fixed.fix: prefill_io_ms = total_io_ms — parallel prefill loads entire model as one transfer

bugs_fixed.description: resident_residual_bytes() used .startswith() on int keys — TypeError edge case
bugs_fixed.root_cause: All keys iterated without isinstance(k, str) guard

bugs_fixed.description: _evict_if_needed could leave orphaned residual keys when base layer evicted early
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Base-layer eviction loop condition could miss eviction trigger
bugs_fixed.fix: Decouple base and residual eviction; add independent budget-based residual eviction loop

bugs_fixed.description: prefetched dict defined but never populated — dead code
bugs_fixed.root_cause: All layers added directly to resident, not prefetched
bugs_fixed.fix: Left as-is — design-level issue beyond bug-fix scope

generation_unchanged.reason: Weights fully resident after prefill; IO=0 during generation

phase_validity.28AE: STILL_VALID — hardware IO measurements independent of simulation
